title: Mazda CMU bench
snapshot_note: Saved progress, not live telemetry. Reopen the private Page for a newer snapshot.
headline: Root55 and home restored. Browser return failed.
summary: The custom page rendered, then a missed GUI heartbeat ended Opera and the timed return failed. Fresh stock home and root55 were separately reverified after an intervening restart. Navigation tests are stopped; work stays on firmware55.

current.scope: USB + SD preserved · AUX not required
current.changes: No intentional firmware, account, network or persistent-settings changes. Intervening restart observed separately.

milestones.title: Root access restored
milestones.detail: Fresh root55 identity and stock home observed after the incident.
milestones.proof: One known root login; uid0, Linux3.0.35, 55.00.750B/cmu150_NA, uptime454.06s, END0 + prompt and closed port.
milestones.limits: Separate recovery does not make the failed browser return successful. No complete boot trace or long-term stability claim.

milestones.title: Exact small-file exports
milestones.proof: Target pre/post MD5 + POSIX CRC + byte counts matched host; host SHA-256 retained.
milestones.limits: Two content copies, not a full-device backup, atomic snapshot or tested restore. No verified second copy.

milestones.title: Larger UART submission
milestones.detail: 7,093 B live submission passed with zero BEL.
milestones.proof: 6,699 B payload · CRC 158748838 · 3.198 s · 111 chunks / 110 gaps · END0 + prompt.
milestones.limits: One accepted profile. Earlier unpaced UNKNOWN is preserved; no universal flow-control claim.

milestones.title: Native dialog + owned cleanup
milestones.detail: One modal appeared and the display returned home.
milestones.proof: Live sleep4 first; exact owned TERM, wait143, cleanup0 and fresh root55. Process cleanup at +42 s.
milestones.limits: Full nonce was unreadable from glare/crop. After frame at +101 s missed the 90 s camera target; lifecycle success is separate from full visual/timing acceptance.

milestones.title: Clearer fresh camera frame
milestones.detail: Userspace UVC exposure control improved legibility.
milestones.proof: Requested manual mode1/exposure82; post-capture observed mode1/exposure87/brightness128 and retained it.
milestones.limits: Original mode8/exposure330/brightness128 preserved. Cause of 82→87 change unassigned; crop and angle remain. No raster processing.

milestones.title: Browser source mapped
milestones.detail: Running entry and exported Navigate binding verified.
milestones.proof: Installed run-Opera sets /jci/gui/index.html and launches with -u, matching live argv. Verified stock bootstrap is the timed-return target.
milestones.limits: Source mapping did not prove a safe reversible navigation experiment. Exact prior focus/history restoration is not claimed.

milestones.title: Browser demo: failed return
milestones.detail: Custom data page rendered; planned stock return failed.
milestones.proof: At about10s GUI_MANAGER missed heartbeat and Opera exited. Planned16s return got ServiceUnknown/rc1; SM logged reset intent. Initial after photo showed startup logo.
milestones.limits: Later fresh home/root recovery is separate. Navigation experiments stopped; only bounded stock heartbeat-source research continues.

tasks.title: Stock heartbeat producer found
tasks.detail: GuiFramework calls native guiManager.javascriptHeartbeat() every1s. Leaving the stock document removes its normal producer.
tasks.pass: Source and the observed~10s timeout align; no spoofing, disabling, service kill or further browser action.

tasks.title: Preserve evidence and firmware55 tooling
tasks.detail: Keep UART, preservation and clearer-image workflows useful while hardware ships.
tasks.pass: Retain incident/recovery evidence and keep tested tooling and the progress snapshot current without changing the CMU baseline.

tasks.title: Prepare a heartbeat-preserving overlay
tasks.detail: Suggested extension: self-closing native bench-status dialog using the proven owned lifecycle, while stock frontend stays loaded. No live experiment is queued.
tasks.pass: Keep the stock heartbeat untouched and demonstrate bounded owned cleanup without cross-document navigation.

tasks.title: Navigation experiments stopped
tasks.detail: Data rendering passed; standalone navigation lost the heartbeat and return failed. Do not repeat that route.
tasks.pass: A heartbeat-safe design preserves stock supervision and has a verified return before another experiment.

tasks.title: Validate USB media and SD navigation
tasks.detail: Device enumeration does not prove usable media or navigation.
tasks.pass: Actual feature behavior demonstrated; preserve existing USB / SD content and settings.

tasks.title: Establish faster verified transport
tasks.detail: USB hub / Ethernet hardware is in shipping for a few days; driver, link and SSH checks follow arrival.
tasks.pass: Known device + UID, working link/login and a small checksum-matched transfer without persistent reconfiguration.

tasks.title: Preservation and recovery study
tasks.detail: Map storage and device-unique state before broader acquisition.
tasks.pass: Consistency limits and restore method identified; independent second copy and representative restore tested.

tasks.title: Physical commander acceptance
tasks.detail: Software input is not proof of physical commander operation.
tasks.pass: Agent-operable actuation and observed end-to-end response; no human bench interaction assumed.

tasks.title: Controlled shutdown / power capture
tasks.detail: USB ACC relay is in shipping for a few days; wiring, B+ / ACC behavior and shutdown timing remain unverified.
tasks.pass: Owned power control and safe shutdown observation before any automatic cycle.

tasks.title: Evaluate v73 later
tasks.detail: No upgrade now. Retain firmware55 while hardware ships and preservation/access work continues.
tasks.pass: Separate upgrade plan establishes exact hardware/region/package path and recovery limits while preserving USB + SD.

blockers.title: Hardware is in shipping
blockers.text: USB hub / Ethernet and USB ACC relay are expected in a few days. Arrival and agent-operable attachment gate those checks; no manual bench task is assigned to the user.

blockers.title: Browser heartbeat coupling
blockers.text: The custom page rendered but the timed return failed after heartbeat loss and Opera exit. Current root/home recovery is verified separately; navigation experiments remain stopped.

blockers.title: Firmware / retrofit compatibility
blockers.text: Firmware55 is below Mazda’s stated v70 retrofit-hub prerequisite. Exact hub identity and actual USB / SD behavior remain pending; this does not authorize a firmware upgrade.

blockers.title: Evidence coverage
blockers.text: Camera crop/angle, complete backup, restore behavior and second-copy protection remain open. A working dialog or file hash does not close these gaps.
